title: krn pr ship runs the instruction-bytes rule before it pushes
body:
Outcome: krn pr ship refuses to push when test/rules/instruction-bytes.test.ts fails. Why: 4 of the 6 incorrect Sonnet replays in C3 (476 493 498 514, tasks/t-hx8fq1q.json) failed only this rule, found at CI. Proof: a ship test sees the push refused with the rule's message. Scope: src/ci/ship.ts and its test.
Evidence: .krn/runs/qwen-research/report.md (Qwen 4 audit) verified by krn-reader against HEAD 8152cee.
